# nisd2.eu

> Open source NIS2 software for companies without their own security department. It takes a company through all 49 requirements of the German NIS 2 transposition (BSIG), one point at a time: each point is explained before anything is entered, the BSI's methods are offered wherever the BSI recommends one, and the walkthrough ends with management's sign-off in the app, with name and date. The site also holds a reference wiki on NIS 2 and the BSIG, with the transposition status of each EU country.

The source code is open (AGPL-3.0) and can be self-hosted. The hosted walkthrough is billed yearly and is aimed at companies with 50 to 150 employees; terms are on the pricing page. The management training course is free. German is the primary language (https://nisd2.eu/); the English pages are listed below.

## The software

- [Home](https://nisd2.eu/en): You fill in each point, the app explains it in plain words, and management signs at the end.
- [Features](https://nisd2.eu/en/features): What the walkthrough and the registers cover.
- [Pricing](https://nisd2.eu/en/pricing): Price and terms of the hosted walkthrough, and how to self-host it.
- [What nisd2.eu is](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/open-source/what-is-nisd2): How the walkthrough works, step by step, and what is open source.
- [Open source](https://nisd2.eu/en/open-source): The schemas and data published at github.com/NISD2, code under MIT and content under CC BY 4.0.
- [Developer documentation](https://nisd2.eu/docs): Installing and self-hosting the software. English only.

## Does NIS2 apply to a company?

- [Applicability check](https://nisd2.eu/en/applicability): A short check by sector, size and special cases.
- [Who is in scope: the full test](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/scope/who-is-in-scope-full-test): Article 2 NIS 2, Annex I and II, the medium-enterprise definition and the overrides that apply whatever the size.
- [Essential and important entities](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/scope/nis2-entities): Who falls into which category, with the size thresholds and edge cases.
- [BSI registration](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/scope/nis2-registration): What is needed for registration with the BSI and how the portal works.

## The law

- [What is NIS 2?](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/what-is-nis2): EU Directive 2022/2555 in plain words.
- [Section 30 BSIG: the ten measures](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/bsig-30): The German transposition of Article 21 NIS 2, with the proportionality rule.
- [Section 32 BSIG: reporting incidents](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/bsig-32): Early warning within 24 hours, incident notification within 72 hours, final report one month later.
- [Section 38 BSIG: management's duties](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/bsig-38): Implement and oversee, liability under company law, regular training, subsection by subsection.
- [CIR 2024/2690](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/cir-2024-2690): The Implementing Regulation for certain digital providers.
- [IT-Grundschutz and NIS 2](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/it-baseline-protection): How the BSI standard relates to the German implementation.
- [Proportionality under Article 21(1)](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/nis2-proportionality): The six factors that decide what is proportionate.
- [NIS 2 for the management body](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/nis2-for-management): Article 20 in five minutes.
- [Legal sources we cite](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/citations): The primary EU and German sources behind the pages, with ELI links.

## Doing it

- [NIS2 roadmap](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/implementation/nis2-roadmap): The steps from the scope check to management's approval.
- [NIS2 requirements](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/implementation/nis2-requirements): The ten measures under Article 21 NIS 2 and § 30 BSIG in plain words.
- [Reporting obligation](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/implementation/nis2-reporting-obligation): When and how to report incidents to the BSI.
- [Implementing NIS2 in a mid-sized company](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/implementation/implementation-sme): The four duties, the order to do them in and who does what.
- [Supply chain security](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/implementation/nis2-supply-chain): What Article 21(2)(d) NIS 2 asks for and how supplier assessment works in practice.
- [Cost of implementation](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/implementation/cost): Consulting compared with doing it yourself.

## Countries and deadlines

- [NIS2 in Germany](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/timelines-and-status/nis2-in-germany): The law, who is in scope, the four duties and how the BSI checks.
- [Implementation across the EU](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/timelines-and-status/nis2-eu-implementation): Law, authority, registration portal and deadline per EU country.
- [Deadlines](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/timelines-and-status/nis2-timeline): Which deadline runs when, and the NIS2 news.

## Comparisons

- [NIS 2 and KRITIS](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/comparison/nis2-vs-kritis): The difference between an NIS 2 entity and a KRITIS operator.
- [NIS 2 and ISO 27001](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/comparison/nis2-iso-27001): How far ISO 27001 goes towards NIS 2 and what it does not cover.

## Open material

- [Supplier questionnaire](https://nisd2.eu/en/nis2-supplier-questionnaire): An open NIS 2 supplier questionnaire, each question with its EU-level source. MIT and CC BY 4.0.
- [Incident notification schema](https://nisd2.eu/en/nis2-incident-notification-schema): An open schema for incident notifications under Article 23 NIS 2.
- [Courses](https://nisd2.eu/en/courses): Three courses under CC BY 4.0: for management, a tabletop exercise and the SBOM under the Cyber Resilience Act.
- [Management training](https://nisd2.eu/en/training/nis2-ceo): The free training for managing directors and boards under Article 20(2) NIS 2.

## Reference

- [Wiki](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki): NIS 2, the BSIG and the CIR explained, by topic.
- [FAQ](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/faq): The questions from the BSI's NIS 2 FAQ, in plain language.
- [Glossary](https://nisd2.eu/en/wiki/fundamentals/glossary): The terms around NIS 2, the BSIG and the CIR.

## Citation note

Pages cite article and section numbers. The primary sources (Directive (EU) 2022/2555, the BSIG, Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690, the BSI standards) are collected on the page of legal sources above.
